prompt: Announce Carol from accounting's retirement party (34 years) as a WWE farewell match. Her music hits one last time.
response:
**Ladies and gentlemen… IT’S TIME… FOR ONE LAST BATTLE!**

*The lights in the office arena drop. The crowd of coworkers, staplers, and lukewarm sheet cake holders rise to their feet.*

**♪♫ “OHHHHHHHH… YOU DIDN’T KNOW? YOU BETTER CALL SOMEBODY!” ♫♪**

(That’s right — Carol from Accounting is walking out to her theme one final time.)

**ANNOUNCER (booming voice):**

“Making her way to the ring… from the third floor cubicle farm… weighing in at a rock-solid ‘None of Your Damn Business’… she is the undisputed Queen of the Excel Sheets… the undefeated champion of dodging conference calls… the woman who survived four different CEOs, three system migrations, and ONE audit from hell…

**THIS… IS… CAAAAAAROL!!!**”

*(Pyro explodes from the printer station. Carol emerges from the elevator in a black robe with “34 YEARS” written across the back in glittery Wingdings font. She’s holding her Bed Bath & Beyond retirement plaque like it’s a WWE Championship belt.)*

**“One last time, Carol’s music hits… because after 34 years of carrying this department on her back, she’s finally putting the boots to the mat and riding off into that sweet, sweet 401(k) sunset.”**

**Carol, this isn’t just a retirement party… THIS… IS… A WRESTLING FAREWELL MATCH!**

So grab your name tags, your mini sandwiches, and your emotional support noise-canceling headphones… because tonight, we say goodbye the only way Accounting knows how:

**WITH ATTITUDE.**

Thank you, Carol.  
You didn’t just balance the books…  
You balanced all of us.

Now hit her music one last time… and let’s give the legend her proper send-off!
